title: Quick beef stroganoff with rice
toddlerSplit: Serve the toddlers straight after the crème fraîche goes in, before the mustard and black pepper. Chop their beef strips small — long strips are hard for a 2-year-old.
steps: Rice on to simmer, covered, 12 minutes.
Fry sliced onion 4 minutes, add mushrooms, cook hard 4 minutes until browned.
Push aside, sear the beef strips 2 minutes — no longer or they toughen.
Add stock and smoked paprika, bubble 2 minutes, stir in crème fraîche.
Stir mustard and plenty of pepper into the pan, scatter parsley, serve over rice.
